note: Authored advisory snapshot for the Java pilot. It is data, not code: each entry names a Maven coordinate prefix and a severity, so adding one is a reviewed data edit. An empty or absent snapshot is an error in the guest auditor, because a dependency audit that found nothing because it knew nothing is the same failure mode as a scan that did not run.
